title: Add LOG_HEXDUMP_DBG to l2/lichen_l2_rx.c parse failures
description: lichen_l2_rx.c processes incoming L2 frames. On parse failures (bad signature, truncated, wrong version), add LOG_HEXDUMP_DBG(data, MIN(len, 32), "L2 RX parse failure") before returning error. Gate behind CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG_HEXDUMP (new Kconfig bool, default n). Verify: build compiles with and without the config.
